plain_english_summary: Deterministic neural-signal encoding and retrieval system for bounded extracellular recording lanes.
commercial_wedge: For neurotech research-infrastructure teams needing deterministic, reproducible spike-event encoding of extracellular neural recordings with auditable proof lineage. Business value: reproducibility and auditability for spike-event pipelines. Note: this is a lossy spike extractor, not a lossless signal compressor.
technical_wedge: Deterministic spike-event encoding applied to extracellular neural signals, evidenced by DANDI 000034 validation and a counted IBL second-target PASS under bounded refinement. Codec is a lossy spike extractor; headline compression ratios are window-scoped.
ideal_first_buyer: Neurotech research-infrastructure team or academic neuroscience platform needing deterministic spike-event encoding with proof lineage.
deployment_model: Python package on PyPI (`zpe-neuro`), private-staged proof surface.
not_claimed: No broad neural generality — extracellular lane only
family_position: Validates ZPE encoding generality to neural signal domains. Staged/validation tier alongside Mocap, Prosody, and Bio.
